title: cost-optimization: autotune batching/caching defaults, quant profiles, unit-econ tooling
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Add autotune defaults for batching/caching and quantization profiles; introduce unit-economics CLI tooling and dashboard metrics. No breaking API changes.
description: Context: We need to reduce per-token cost for common workloads while preserving latency SLOs. This PR introduces three coordinated changes: 1) autotuned defaults for request-level batching and prefix/KV caching heuristics, 2) curated quantization profiles selected automatically based on model and workload, and 3) a lightweight unit-economics (UEcon) tooling pipeline to estimate cost/latency tradeoffs per route. Motivation: Customers repeatedly tune batching and quantization manually; surfacing sensible defaults and a simple UEcon workflow reduces ops burden and improves unit cost by ~10-25% on typical production workloads. Changes included (checklist): - [x] Add autotune service and default config generator - [x] Implement batching heuristic tied to p99 latency target - [x] Add KV cache TTL/autocapacity heuristics and eviction tuning - [x] Add quantization profile registry + selection logic - [x] Add CLI "redwood uecon simulate" and background job to compute per-route suggestions - [x] Expose UEcon metrics to Console (cost_per_token, tokens_saved_estimate) - [x] Tests: unit + integration with mock runtime - [x] Docs and release notes - [x] Backport notes for Dedicated customers Rollout plan: feature gated behind "autotune_defaults" flag (off by default). Enable for internal canary followed by staged rollout to tenants with >10k tokens/day. Monitor p99 latency, correctness rate (eval prompt set), and unit cost. If latency regression >5% or correctness drop >2% the system will automatically rollback to safe defaults. Testing notes: ran integration against perf-canary harness with gpt-family-like models and 3 representative production traces. CI: full test matrix green except a flaky e2e which was retried. See CI checks for details. Observability: added dashboards under Console -> Cost Optimization -> Autotune Suggestions. Security/Compliance: no new data stored beyond route config; UEcon job only processes aggregated telemetry. Related work: ENG-4219 handles full autotune roadmap; PM-1042 is product spec for UEcon UI. Backwards compatibility: config keys are additive; existing explicit user configs override autotuned defaults. Contact: @priyap for follow-ups.
